rows.source_ko: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this ruleis to prescribe matters delegated by the Grain Management Act and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act , and matters necessary for the implementation thereof.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) This Rule prescribes matters delegated by the Grain Management Act and its Enforcement Decree, and matters necessary for their implementation.

rows.source_ko: Article 1-2 (Establishment and Operation of Rice Supply and Demand Management System) ① The rice supply and demand management system pursuant to Article 5-2, Paragraph 1 of the Grain Management Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”)(hereinafter referred to as the “Rice Supply and Demand Management System”) shall be established and operated to collect, analyze, and manage the data in each of the following subparagraphs.
rows.text_en: Article 1-2 (Establishment and Operation of the Rice Supply and Demand Management System) ① The rice supply and demand management system under Article 5-2(1) of the Grain Management Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”; the system hereinafter referred to as the “rice supply and demand management system”) shall be established and operated to collect, analyze, and manage the data specified in the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. Data on cultivated area and yield per unit area related to rice production
rows.text_en: 1. Data on cultivated area and yield per unit area related to rice production

rows.source_ko: 2. Data on rice consumption related to rice demand
rows.text_en: 2. Data on rice consumption related to rice demand

rows.source_ko: 3. Data on the current status of facilities, such as comprehensive rice processing plants, pursuant to Article 22 of the Act on the Inventory and Distribution of Rice
rows.text_en: 3. Data on facilities, including comprehensive rice processing plants under Article 22 of the Act, relating to rice inventory and distribution

rows.source_ko: 4. Data related to rice prices
rows.text_en: 4. Data related to rice prices

rows.source_ko: 5. Other data deemed necessary by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs for the management of rice supply and demand
rows.text_en: 5. Other data deemed necessary by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs for the management of rice supply and demand

rows.source_ko: ② Persons performing duties related to the management of rice supply and demand must input relevant information using the rice supply and demand management system.
rows.text_en: ② Persons performing duties related to the management of rice supply and demand must input relevant information using the rice supply and demand management system.

rows.source_ko: ③ The head of the Korea Rural Economic Institute pursuant to the “Act on the Establishment, Operation, and Promotion of Government-funded Research Institutes, etc.” (hereinafter referred to as the “President of the Korea Rural Economic Institute” in this Article) may inspect the status of the establishment and operation of the rice supply and demand management system and take necessary measures for supplementation and improvement, etc., for the efficient operation of the rice supply and demand management system.
rows.text_en: ③ The head of the Korea Rural Economic Institute pursuant to the “Act on the Establishment, Operation, and Promotion of Government-funded Research Institutes, etc.” (hereinafter referred to as the “President of the Korea Rural Economic Institute” in this Article) may inspect the status of the establishment and operation of the rice supply and demand management system and take necessary measures for supplementation and improvement, etc., for the efficient operation of the rice supply and demand management system.

rows.source_ko: ④ In addition to the matters prescribed in paragraphs 1 through 3, matters necessary for the establishment and operation of the rice supply and demand management system shall be determined by the President of the Korea Rural Economic Institute.
rows.text_en: ④ In addition to the matters prescribed in paragraphs 1 through 3, matters necessary for the establishment and operation of the rice supply and demand management system shall be determined by the President of the Korea Rural Economic Institute.

rows.source_ko: 제1조의6(정부관리양곡 보관 실태점검) ① 법 제9조의3제1항에 따른 정부관리양곡 보관 실태점검(이하 “실태점검”이라 한다)에는 다음 각 호의 사항이 포함되어야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1-6 (Inspection of Storage Status of Government-Managed Grain) ① The inspection of storage status of government-managed grain pursuant to Article 9-3(1) of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “status inspection”) shall include the following matters:

rows.source_ko: 1. 정부관리양곡의 재고관리 현황
rows.text_en: 1. Current Status of Inventory Management of Government-Managed Grain

rows.source_ko: 2. 정부관리양곡 보관시설(이하 “보관시설”이라 한다)ㆍ장비 등의 안전 관리 실태
rows.text_en: 2. Status of Safety Management of Government-Managed Grain Storage Facilities (hereinafter referred to as “Storage Facilities”) and Equipment, etc.

rows.source_ko: 3. 보관 정부관리양곡의 품질 관리 실태 및 보관창고 등급
rows.text_en: 3. Quality Control Status of Stored Government-Managed Grain and Storage Warehouse Grades

rows.source_ko: 4. 그 밖에 정부관리양곡의 안전 관리 및 품질 관리를 위하여 농림축산식품부장관이 필요하다고 인정하는 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Other matters deemed necessary by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs for the safety and quality control of government-managed grains

rows.source_ko: ② 실태점검은 다음 각 호의 구분에 따라 실시한다.
rows.text_en: ② Status inspections shall be conducted according to the classifications in each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 정기점검: 반기 1회 이상 정기적으로 실시하는 점검
rows.text_en: 1. Regular inspection: An inspection conducted regularly at least once every six months.

rows.source_ko: 2. 수시점검: 안전 관리 및 품질 관리를 위하여 필요한 경우 실시하는 점검
rows.text_en: 2. Unscheduled Inspection: Inspection conducted when necessary for safety and quality management

rows.source_ko: ③ 제1항 및 제2항에서 규정한 사항 외에 보관 실태점검에 필요한 사항은 농림축산식품부장관이 정한다.
rows.text_en: ③ In addition to the matters prescribed in Paragraphs 1 and 2, matters necessary for the inspection of storage conditions shall be determined by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs.
[This Article Newly Inserted Aug. 27, 2026]

rows.source_ko: 제1조의7(실태점검 결과의 공표) ① 농림축산식품부장관은 법 제9조의3제3항에 따라 실태점검 결과를 공표하는 때에는 다음 각 호의 사항을 포함해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1-7 (Publication of Results of Fact-Finding Inspections) ① When the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs publishes the results of fact-finding inspections pursuant to Article 9-3, Paragraph 3 of the Act , he/she shall include the following matters:

rows.source_ko: 1. 보관시설 등의 명칭 및 위치
rows.text_en: 1. Name and location of storage facilities, etc.

rows.source_ko: 2. 보관시설 등의 안전 관리 및 정부관리양곡의 품질 관리 상태
rows.text_en: 2. Safety management of storage facilities, etc. and quality control status of government-managed grain

rows.source_ko: 3. 조치나 시정이 필요한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters requiring action or correction

rows.source_ko: 4. 그 밖에 보관시설 등의 안전 관리 및 품질 관리를 위하여 농림축산식품부장관이 필요하다고 인정하는 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Other matters deemed necessary by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs for the safety and quality management of storage facilities, etc.

rows.source_ko: ② 농림축산식품부장관은 법 제9조의3제3항에 따라 실태점검이 완료된 날부터 3개월 이내에 그 결과를 농림축산식품부의 인터넷 홈페이지에 게시하는 방법으로 공표한다.
rows.text_en: ② The Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs shall, in accordance with Article 9-3, Paragraph 3 of the Act , announce the results within three months from the date the inspection of the actual conditions is completed by posting them on the internet homepage of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs.
[This Article Newly Inserted Aug. 27, 2026]

rows.source_ko: 제1조의8(정부관리양곡 종합관리시스템 구축ㆍ운영) ① 법 제9조의4제1항에 따른 정부관리양곡 종합관리시스템(이하 “종합관리시스템”이라 한다)은 다음 각 호의 업무를 수행하기 위하여 구축ㆍ운영한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1-8 (Establishment and Operation of Government-Managed Grain Comprehensive Management System) ① The Government-Managed Grain Comprehensive Management System pursuant to Article 9-4, Paragraph 1 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Comprehensive Management System”) shall be established and operated to perform the tasks set forth in each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 정부관리양곡 취득ㆍ보관ㆍ가공ㆍ공급 현황 관리에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 1. Duties regarding the management of the status of acquisition, storage, processing, and supply of government-managed grain

rows.source_ko: 2. 정부관리양곡 관리ㆍ운용에 필요한 통계 수집 및 분석에 관한 업무
rows.text_en: 2. Tasks regarding the collection and analysis of statistics necessary for the management and operation of government-managed grain

rows.source_ko: 3. 그 밖에 정부관리양곡의 관리ㆍ운용을 위하여 농림축산식품부장관이 필요하다고 인정하는 업무
rows.text_en: 3. Other tasks deemed necessary by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs for the management and operation of government-managed grain

rows.source_ko: ② 정부관리양곡의 취득ㆍ보관ㆍ가공ㆍ공급과 관련된 업무를 수행하는 자는 종합관리시스템을 이용하여 관련 정보를 입력해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② Persons performing duties related to the acquisition, storage, processing, and supply of government-managed grain must input relevant information using the comprehensive management system.

rows.source_ko: ③ 제1항 및 제2항에서 규정한 사항 외에 종합관리시스템의 구축ㆍ운영에 필요한 사항은 국립농산물품질관리원장이 정한다.
rows.text_en: ③ In addition to the matters prescribed in Paragraphs 1 and 2, matters necessary for the establishment and operation of the comprehensive management system shall be determined by the Director of the National Agricultural Products Quality Management Service.
[This Article Newly Inserted Aug. 27, 2026]

rows.text_en: Article 2 (Application for Import Permit for Rice, etc.) The application for an import permit for rice, etc. pursuant to Article 14, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree of the Grain Management Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”) is as in Form No. 1 attached hereto .
[Wholly Amended Oct. 1, 2009]
Article 2-2 Deleted <Mar. 11, 2015>

rows.source_ko: 제2조의3(수입이익금의 부과대상 품목) 법 제13조의2제1항에서 “농림축산식품부령으로 정하는 품목”이란 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 양곡(사료용 양곡은 제외한다)을 말한다. <개정 2013. 3. 23., 2019. 8. 26.>
rows.text_en: Article 2-3 (Grains Subject to Collection of Import Profits) In Article 13-2 (1) of the Act, the term “items prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs” means any of the following grains (excluding grains intended for feed). <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; Aug. 26, 2019>

rows.source_ko: 1. 소비자 시판용 미곡
rows.text_en: 1. Rice for consumer sale

rows.source_ko: 2. 가공용 미곡과 맥류(麥類) 중 보리
rows.text_en: 2. Rice for processing and barley among cereals

rows.source_ko: 3. 두류(豆類) 중 대두ㆍ팥ㆍ녹두ㆍ땅콩
rows.text_en: 3. Among legumes, soybeans, red beans, mung beans, and peanuts

rows.source_ko: 4. 메밀ㆍ감자
rows.text_en: 4. Buckwheat and Potato

rows.source_ko: 5. 영 제2조제1항제2호에 따른 교잡(交雜)곡물, 귀리, 율무, 밀의 분쇄물, 가루, 압착물 중 농림축산식품부장관이 정하여 고시하는 품목
rows.text_en: 5. Among the crossbred grains, oats, Job's tears, and ground, flour, and pressed products of wheat pursuant to Article 2 , Paragraph 1 , Subparagraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree, items designated and notified by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs

rows.source_ko: 6. 영 제2조제1항제2호에 따른 교잡곡물, 귀리, 율무, 밀의 분쇄물 또는 가루의 응집물 중 농림축산식품부장관이 정하여 고시하는 품목
rows.text_en: 6. Items designated and notified by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs among the ground or aggregated flour products of crossbred grains, oats, Job's tears, and wheat pursuant to Article 2, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree
[Wholly Amended Oct. 1, 2009]

rows.source_ko: 제2조의4(수입이익금의 산정 등) ① 농림축산식품부장관이 법 제13조의2제1항에 따라 국내가격과 수입가격의 차액의 범위에서 부과ㆍ징수할 수 있는 수입이익금은 양곡의 판매수입금에서 농림축산식품부장관이 정하여 고시하는 비용산정기준 및 방법에 따라 산정된 해당 양곡의 물품대금ㆍ운임ㆍ보험료, 그 밖의 수입에 소요되는 비목의 비용과 제세공과금ㆍ보관료ㆍ운송료ㆍ판매수수료 등 국내 판매에 소요되는 비목의 비용을 공제한 금액이나 양곡의 수입자로 결정된 자가 수입자 결정 시 납입하기로 한 금액으로 한다. <개정 2013. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: Article 2-4 (Calculation of Import Profits, etc.) ① The import profits that the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs may impose and collect pursuant to Article 13-2, Paragraph 1 of the Act within the scope of the difference between the domestic price and the import price shall be the amount obtained by deducting from the sales revenue of grain the cost of goods, freight, insurance premiums, and other expenses for import items, as well as expenses for domestic sales items such as taxes and public charges, storage fees, transportation fees, and sales commissions, calculated in accordance with the cost calculation standards and methods prescribed and notified by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs; or the amount that the person determined as the importer of grain agreed to pay at the time of the importer determination. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013>

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제13조의2에 따라 수입이익금을 낼 의무가 있는 자는 농림축산식품부장관이 정하여 고시하는 기한까지 다음 각 호에 따른 기금 또는 특별회계에 수입이익금을 내야 한다. <개정 2013. 3. 23., 2015. 2. 2., 2020. 5. 12.>
rows.text_en: ② Any person obligated to pay import profits pursuant to Article 13-2 of the Act shall pay the import profits to the funds or special accounts set forth in each of the following subparagraphs by the deadline prescribed and notified by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs . <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; Feb. 2, 2015; May 12, 2020>

rows.source_ko: 1. 제2조의3제1호에 따른 미곡: 「농업ㆍ농촌 공익기능 증진 직접지불제도 운영에 관한 법률」 제25조에 따른 농업ㆍ농촌 공익기능 증진 직접지불기금
rows.text_en: 1. Rice pursuant to Article 2-3, Subparagraph 1 : Direct Payment Fund for the Promotion of Public Interest Functions in Agriculture and Rural Areas pursuant to Article 25 of the Act on the Operation of the Direct Payment System for the Promotion of Public Interest Functions in Agriculture and Rural Areas

rows.source_ko: 2. 제2조의3제2호에 따른 양곡: 「정부기업예산법」 제3조제3호에 따른 양곡관리특별회계
rows.text_en: 2. Grains pursuant to Article 2-3, Subparagraph 2 : Special Account for Grain Management pursuant to Article 3, Subparagraph 3 of the Government Enterprise Budget Act

rows.source_ko: 3. 제2조의3제3호부터 제6호까지에 따른 양곡:「농수산물유통 및 가격안정에 관한 법률」 제54조에 따른 농산물가격안정기금
rows.text_en: 3. Grains pursuant to Subparagraphs 3 through 6 of Article 2-3 : Agricultural Products Price Stabilization Fund pursuant to Article 54 of the Act on the Distribution and Price Stabilization of Agricultural and Fishery Products

rows.source_ko: ③ 제2항제3호에 따른 수입이익금을 납입하여야 하는 자는 해당 수입이익금이 1천만원 이하인 경우에는 신용카드, 직불카드 등으로 납입할 수 있다. <신설 2017. 11. 16.>
rows.text_en: ③ Persons required to pay import profits under paragraph (2) 3 may pay them by credit or debit card, etc., where the amount of such import profits does not exceed 10 million won. <Newly inserted Nov. 16, 2017>
[Wholly Amended Oct. 1, 2009]

rows.source_ko: 제3조(농협등보관양곡의 보고 방법 및 절차) ① 농업협동조합등[농업협동조합(「농업협동조합법」 제2조제1호에 따른 조합을 포함한다) 또는 영 제16조제1항 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 자를 말한다. 이하 같다]은 법 제17조제1항에 따라 매 분기 종료 후 1개월 이내에 농협등보관양곡(농림축산식품부장관이 법 제16조제3항에 따라 농업협동조합등에게 양곡을 매입하고 판매하게 할 수 있도록 보관하고 있는 양곡을 말한다. 이하 같다)의 종류 및 재고량을 농림축산식품부장관에게 보고해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Method and Procedure for Reporting Grain Stored by Agricultural Cooperatives, etc.) ① Agricultural cooperatives, etc. [referring to agricultural cooperatives (including cooperatives under subparagraph 1 of Article 2 of the Agricultural Cooperatives Act ) or persons falling under any of the subparagraphs of Article 16, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree; hereinafter the same applies] shall, in accordance with Article 17, Paragraph 1 of the Act, report to the Minister of Agriculture , Food and Rural Affairs the types and inventory quantities of grain stored by agricultural cooperatives, etc. (referring to grain that the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs stores so that the Minister may purchase and sell grain from agricultural cooperatives, etc. in accordance with Article 16, Paragraph 3 of the Act ; hereinafter the same applies) within one month after the end of each quarter.

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에서 규정한 사항 외에 농협등보관양곡의 보고에 필요한 사항은 농림축산식품부장관이 정한다.
rows.text_en: ② In addition to the matters prescribed in Paragraph 1, matters necessary for the reporting of grain stored by agricultural cooperatives, etc. shall be determined by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs.
[This Article Newly Inserted Aug. 27, 2026]

rows.source_ko: 제4조(양곡가공업의 신고 등) ① 법 제19조 및 영 제21조제1항에 따라 제분업ㆍ제조업이나 도정업의 신고를 하려는 자는 다음 각 호의 구분에 따른 신고서 및 서류를 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수 또는 구청장(자치구의 구청장을 말한다. 이하 같다)에게 제출(전자문서에 의한 제출을 포함한다)하여야 한다. <개정 2017. 11. 16.>
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Reporting, etc. of Grain Processing Business) ① Any person who intends to report a flour milling business, manufacturing business, or rice milling business pursuant to Article 19 of the Act and Article 21, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall submit the report form and documents classified according to each of the following subparagraphs to the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Governor, or the Head of a District (referring to the head of an autonomous district; hereinafter the same applies) (including submission by electronic document). <Amended Nov. 16, 2017>

rows.source_ko: 1. 제분업ㆍ제조업의 신고를 하려는 자: 별지 제2호서식의 양곡가공업(제분업용ㆍ제조업용) 신고서와 다음 각 목의 서류
rows.text_en: 1. Persons intending to report flour milling or manufacturing business: The Grain Processing Business (for flour milling or manufacturing) Report Form No. 2 and the documents in each of the following subparagraphs

rows.source_ko: 가. 별지 제3호서식의 동력 및 기계시설 내역표
rows.text_en: a. Details of Power and Mechanical Facilities ( Form No. 3)

rows.source_ko: 나. 원료처리 및 제품생산 능력표(제조업의 경우만 해당한다)
rows.text_en: B. Raw material processing and product production capacity table (applicable only to manufacturing businesses)

rows.source_ko: 2. 도정업의 신고를 하려는 자: 별지 제4호서식의 양곡가공업(도정업용) 신고서와 별지 제3호서식의 동력 및 기계시설 내역표
rows.text_en: 2. Person intending to report the rice milling business: Grain Processing Business (for Rice Milling Business) Report Form ( Attached Form No. 4 ) and Details of Power and Machinery Facilities ( Attached Form No. 3).

rows.source_ko: ② 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수 또는 구청장은 제1항에 따른 신고를 받은 때에는 그 내용이 제5조에 따른 시설기준에 적합한지를 확인한 후 별지 제5호서식의 양곡가공업 신고대장에 기재하고, 제분업ㆍ제조업의 신고를 한 자에게는 별지 제6호서식의 양곡가공업(제분업용ㆍ제조업용) 신고증을, 도정업의 신고를 한 자에게는 별지 제7호서식의 양곡가공업(도정업용) 신고증을 각각 발급(전자문서에 의한 발급을 포함한다)하여야 한다. <개정 2017. 11. 16.>
rows.text_en: ② When the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Head, or a District Head receives a report under Paragraph 1, they shall verify whether the contents comply with the facility standards under Article 5 , record them in the Grain Processing Business Report Register in Annex 5 , and issue a Grain Processing Business (for Milling/Manufacturing) Report Certificate in Annex 6 to a person who has reported a flour milling or manufacturing business, and a Grain Processing Business (for Rice Milling) Report Certificate in Annex 7 to a person who has reported a rice milling business (including issuance via electronic document). <Amended Nov. 16, 2017>

rows.source_ko: ③ 법 제19조제1항 후단 및 영 제21조제2항에 따라 변경신고를 하려는 자는 별지 제8호서식의 양곡가공업 변경신고서를 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수 또는 구청장에게 제출(전자문서에 의한 제출을 포함한다)하여야 한다. 다만, 영 제21조제2항제4호의 가공능력을 변경하려는 경우에는 그 변경 내용을 반영한 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여야 한다. <개정 2017. 11. 16.>
rows.text_en: ③ Any person who intends to file a report of change pursuant to the latter part of Article 19 , Paragraph 1 of the Act and Article 21 , Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall submit the Report on Change of Grain Processing Business in Annex 8 to the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Governor, or a District Head (including submission via electronic document). However, in the case of intending to change the processing capacity under Article 21, Paragraph 2, Subparagraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree, the following documents reflecting the details of such change shall be attached. <Amended Nov. 16, 2017>

rows.source_ko: 1. 별지 제3호서식의 동력 및 기계시설 내역표
rows.text_en: 1. Details of Power and Mechanical Facilities ( Form No. 3 )

rows.source_ko: 2. 원료처리 및 제품생산 능력표(제조업의 경우만 해당한다)
rows.text_en: 2. Raw Material Processing and Product Production Capacity Table (Applicable only to manufacturing businesses)

rows.source_ko: ④ 법 제19조제3항에 따라 휴업 또는 폐업을 신고하려는 자는 미리 별지 제9호서식의 양곡가공업 휴업ㆍ폐업신고서를 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수 또는 구청장에게 제출(전자문서에 의한 제출을 포함한다)하여야 한다. <개정 2017. 11. 16.>
rows.text_en: ④ Any person who intends to report a suspension or closure of business pursuant to Article 19, Paragraph 3 of the Act shall submit the Report on Suspension or Closure of Grain Processing Business ( Form No. 9 ) in advance to the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, the Mayor, the County Governor, or the District Head (including submission via electronic document). <Amended Nov. 16, 2017>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수 또는 구청장은 제3항이나 제4항에 따른 변경신고 또는 휴업ㆍ폐업신고를 받은 때에는 제2항의 양곡가공업 신고대장에 기재하고, 변경신고를 한 자에게는 해당 양곡가공업 신고증을 갱신하여 발급(전자문서에 의한 발급을 포함한다)하여야 한다. 다만, 제3항 각 호 외의 부분 단서의 가공능력에 대한 변경신고를 받은 경우에는 제5조에 따른 시설기준에 적합한지를 확인하여야 한다. <개정 2017. 11. 16.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ When the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Head, or a District Head receives a report of change or a report of suspension or closure of business pursuant to Paragraph 3 or 4, they shall record it in the grain processing business report ledger referred to in Paragraph 2, and shall renew and issue the relevant grain processing business report certificate (including issuance via electronic document) to the person who filed the report of change. However, in the case of receiving a report of change regarding processing capacity under the proviso of the part other than the subparagraphs of Paragraph 3, they shall verify whether it complies with the facility standards pursuant to Article 5. <Amended Nov. 16, 2017>

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 제2항의 양곡가공업 신고대장은 전자적 처리가 불가능한 특별한 사유가 없으면 전자적 방법으로 작성ㆍ관리하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ⑥ The grain processing business report ledger referred to in Paragraph 2 shall be prepared and managed by electronic means unless there is a special reason why electronic processing is impossible.
[Wholly Amended Oct. 1, 2009]

rows.source_ko: 제4조의2(양곡가공업자의 지위승계 신고) ① 법 제19조의2제3항에 따라 종전의 양곡가공업을 신고한 자의 지위를 승계한 자가 그 승계 사실을 신고하려면 별지 제10호서식의 양곡가공업자 지위승계 신고서에 지위승계를 증명할 수 있는 서류를 첨부하여 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수 또는 구청장에게 제출(전자문서에 의한 제출을 포함한다)하여야 한다. <개정 2017. 11. 16.>
rows.text_en: Article 4-2 (Reporting of Succession to Status of Grain Processor) ①If a person who has succeeded to the status of a person who previously reported a grain processing business pursuant to Article 19-2, Paragraph 3 of the Act wishes to report such succession, they shall submit a Report on Succession to Status of Grain Processor ( Form No. 10 ) to the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Head, or a District Head, attaching documents proving the succession to the status (including submission via electronic document). <Amended Nov. 16, 2017>

rows.source_ko: ② 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수 또는 구청장은 제1항에 따른 신고를 받은 때에는 지위승계 사실을 확인한 후 제4조제2항의 양곡가공업 신고대장에 기재하고 해당 양곡가공업 신고증을 발급(전자문서에 의한 발급을 포함한다)하여야 한다. <개정 2017. 11. 16.>
rows.text_en: ② Upon receiving a report pursuant to Paragraph 1, the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Governor, or a District Head shall verify the fact of succession of status, record it in the grain processing business report ledger under Article 4, Paragraph 2, and issue the relevant grain processing business report certificate (including issuance by electronic document). <Amended Nov. 16, 2017>
[Wholly Amended Oct. 1, 2009]

rows.source_ko: 제5조(양곡가공업의 시설기준) 법 제19조제1항 전단에 따른 시설기준은 별표 3과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Facility Standards for Grain Processing Businesses) The facility standards pursuant to the first part of Article 19, Paragraph 1 of the Act are as set forth in Table 3 .
[Wholly Amended Oct. 1, 2009]
Article 6 Deleted <Aug. 21, 1999>

rows.source_ko: 제7조(제조업의 범위) 영 제21조제1항제2호에서 “농림축산식품부령으로 정하는 규모 이상의 제조업”이란 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 제조업을 말한다. <개정 2013. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Scope of Manufacturing Business) In Article 21, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “manufacturing business of a scale or larger as prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs” refers to any of the manufacturing businesses falling under any of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013>

rows.source_ko: 1. 옥수수를 원료로 하여 전분 및 전분당(물엿ㆍ포도당ㆍ과당)을 제조하는 업으로서 1일(24시간) 24톤 이상의 원료처리시설을 갖춘 제조업
rows.text_en: 1. A manufacturing business that produces starch and starch syrups (corn syrup, glucose, fructose) using corn as a raw material, equipped with a raw material processing facility of 24 tons or more per day (24 hours).

rows.source_ko: 2. 대두를 원료로 하여 식용유지 및 탈지대두를 생산하는 업으로서 1일(24시간) 20톤 이상의 원료처리시설을 갖춘 제조업
rows.text_en: 2. A manufacturing business that produces edible oils and defatted soybeans using soybeans as raw materials, equipped with a raw material processing facility of 20 tons or more per day (24 hours).
[Wholly Amended Oct. 1, 2009]

rows.source_ko: 제7조의2(도정업의 범위) 영 제21조제1항제3호에서 “농림축산식품부령으로 정하는 규모 이상의 도정업”이란 1일(8시간 기준) 2톤 이상의 미곡 또는 1톤 이상의 맥류를 생산할 수 있는 시설을 갖춘 도정업을 말한다. <개정 2013. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: Article 7-2 (Scope of Rice Milling Business) In Article 21 (1) 3 of the Decree, “rice milling business of at least the scale prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs” means a rice milling business equipped with facilities capable of producing at least two metric tons of rice or one metric ton of barley per day (based on eight hours). <Amended Mar. 23, 2013>
[Wholly Amended Oct. 1, 2009]

rows.source_ko: 제7조의3(양곡의 표시사항 등) 법 제20조의2에 따른 양곡의 표시사항과 표시방법은 별표 4와 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 7-3 (Labeling Requirements for Grains, etc.) The labeling requirements and labeling methods for grains pursuant to Article 20-2 of the Act are as set forth in Attached Table 4 .
[Wholly Amended Feb. 1, 2008]

rows.source_ko: 제7조의4(거짓ㆍ과대의 표시ㆍ광고의 범위) 법 제20조의3제2항에 따른 거짓ㆍ과대의 표시 및 거짓ㆍ과대의 광고의 범위는 표시의 경우에는 포장ㆍ용기에, 광고의 경우에는 라디오ㆍ텔레비전ㆍ신문ㆍ잡지ㆍ인터넷이나 그 밖의 방법으로 양곡의 명칭ㆍ품질 등에 대한 정보를 나타내거나 알리는 행위 중 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 것으로 한다. <개정 2013. 10. 2.>
rows.text_en: Article 7-4 (Scope of False or Exaggerated Labeling and Advertising) The scope of false or exaggerated labeling and false or exaggerated advertising pursuant to Article 20-3, Paragraph 2 of the Act shall be any of the acts falling under any of the following subparagraphs among acts of displaying or publicizing information regarding the name, quality, etc. of grains—in the case of labeling, on packaging or containers; and in the case of advertising, via radio, television, newspapers, magazines, the Internet, or other methods. <Amended Oct. 2, 2013>

rows.source_ko: 1. 법 제20조의2에 따른 표시사항과 표시방법을 사실과 다르게 한 표시ㆍ광고
rows.text_en: 1. Labeling or advertising that misrepresents the facts regarding the labeling matters and labeling methods pursuant to Article 20-2 of the Act

rows.source_ko: 2. “최고”ㆍ“가장 좋은” 또는 “특” 등의 표현(“Best”ㆍ“Most”ㆍ“Special”, “特”ㆍ“最高”, “베스트”ㆍ“모스트”ㆍ“스페셜” 등의 표현을 포함하며, 이하 이 호에서 “최고등의 표현”이라 한다)으로 소비자를 현혹하거나 현혹할 우려가 있는 표시ㆍ광고. 다만, 수상경력 등 객관적인 자료나 사업자의 증명에 의하여 최고등의 표현이 사실에 부합하는 것으로 판단되는 경우는 제외한다.
rows.text_en: 2. Labeling or advertising that misleads or is likely to mislead consumers by using expressions such as “highest,” “best,” or “special” (including “Best,” “Most,” “Special,” “特,” “最高” and their Korean transliterations; hereinafter referred to as “superlative expressions”) shall be prohibited, except where such expressions are substantiated by objective evidence such as awards or by proof provided by the business operator.

rows.source_ko: 3. 다른 사업자의 제품을 비방하는 표시ㆍ광고
rows.text_en: 3. Labeling or advertising that disparages the products of other businesses

rows.source_ko: 4. 수상ㆍ인증ㆍ추천 또는 보증에 대한 내용을 실제와 다르게 표현하는 표시ㆍ광고
rows.text_en: 4. Labeling or advertising that misrepresents the actual facts regarding awards, certifications, recommendations, or endorsements
[Wholly Amended Oct. 1, 2009]

rows.source_ko: 제7조의5(혼합 금지 대상 양곡) ① 법 제20조의4제2항 각 호 외의 부분에서 “농림축산식품부령으로 정하는 양곡”이란 미곡을 말한다.
rows.text_en: Article 7-5 (Grains Subject to Prohibition on Mixing) ① In the part other than the subparagraphs of Article 20-4, Paragraph 2 of the Act , “grains prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs” refers to rice.

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 미곡은 벼, 현미 및 쌀(찰벼, 찰현미 및 찹쌀을 제외한다)로서 맨눈으로 원형을 알아볼 수 있는 것(부서진 것을 포함한다)을 말한다. <개정 2017. 11. 16., 2019. 8. 26.>
rows.text_en: ② The grains referred to in Paragraph 1 mean paddy rice, brown rice, and rice (excluding glutinous paddy rice, glutinous brown rice, and glutinous rice) in which their original form can be recognized with the naked eye (including broken pieces). <Amended Nov. 16, 2017; Aug. 26, 2019>
[This Article Newly Inserted June 30, 2015]

rows.source_ko: 제8조(행정처분의 기준) 법 제21조제3항에 따른 영업정지 등 행정처분의 기준은 별표 5와 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 8 (Standards for Administrative Dispositions) The standards for administrative dispositions, such as suspension of business operations, pursuant to Article 21, Paragraph 3 of the Act are as set forth in Attached Table 5 .
[Wholly Amended Feb. 1, 2008]

rows.source_ko: 제9조(미곡유통업의 육성) 농림축산식품부장관은 법 제22조제2항에 따른 미곡의 매입자금을 생산자인 농민과의 계약재배를 통하여 원료벼를 확보하는 자에게 우선 지원할 수 있다. <개정 2013. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: Article 9 (Promotion of Rice Distribution Business) The Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs may provide priority support for rice purchase funds under Article 22, Paragraph 2 of the Act to those who secure raw rice through contract farming with farmers who are producers. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013>
[Wholly Amended Oct. 1, 2009]
